2. The instant Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the impugned Order dated 9-4-2007 passed by the learned District Judge, Dhaka in Transfer Miscellaneous Case, No.327 of 2007withdrawing the title suit No. 217 of 2002 from the Arrha Rin Adalat, 1st Court, (Joint District Judge) Dhaka and thereby transferring the same to the Artha Rill Adalat, 301 Court, Dhaka, should not be set-aside. 

 3. The brief facts, relevant for disposal of  this Rule, as have been stated in the revisional application, in short, are that the opposite party- bank as plaintiff instituted a suit being Title Suit No. 217 of 2002 in the Court of the Artha Rin Adalat and Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka against the present petitioner for recovery of Taka 9,05,53,300. While the suit was so pending the opposite party, the present petitioner entered appearance by filing Vokalatnama and thereafter filed a written-statement against the plaintiff's case denying the material allegations made in the plaint. The plaintiff-bank on 5-4-2007 filed an application under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure in the Court of the learned District Judge, Dhaka praying for transferring the afore-said suit from the Court of the Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Dhaka to any other Court of the Artha Rin Adalat for trial of the same. 

 4. The learned District Judge, Dhaka by his impugned order dated 9-4-2007 transferred the instant case to the Artha Rin Adalat No.3, Dhaka for hearing and disposal. 

 5. Being aggrieved by the impugned order dated 9-4-2007 defendant-opposite party as petitioner preferred the instant revisional application before this Court and obtained the present Rule with an order of stay of operation of the impugned order passed in Transfer Miscellaneous Case No.327 of 2007 and a direction to proceed with Title Suit No.217 of 2002 in the Court of the Joint District Judge and Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Dhaka in usual course. 

 6. Mr Pankaj Kumar Kundu, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the case in question till date is pending before Artha Rin Adalat No.1 as per direction of this Court. He further submits that he has taken additional ground that the learned District Judge under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure cannot transfer the case of Artha Rin Adalat violating the provision of section 5(10) of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003, wherein it has been specifically provided that the Artha Rin Adalat's case should be tried by the learned District Judge under the authority of the said Ain and not by any other law He further submits that the Courts below in transferring the instant Title Suit under section 24 of the said Code has seriously committed an error of law and therefore the impugned order is liable to be set-aside. 

 8. Considered the submissions of the learned Advocates of both the sides and perused the impugned order dated 9-4-2007 passed by the learned District Judge, Dhaka. On perusal of the same it appears that the learned District Judge himself admitted the Transfer Miscellaneous Case under section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, whereas the case praying for transfer is a case under Artha Rin Adalat which is a special law, i.e., Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003. There is a specific provision for Transfer of the Artha Rin case and it has been specifically provides that the Artha Rin Adalat dealt with the matter in accordance with the law of Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 nor under the any other law. Although the learned District Judge has the jurisdiction to transfer the Artha Cases from one Court to another Court of competent jurisdiction not under the Code of Civil Procedure but under the provisions of Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003. From perusal of the provisions of section 5(10) of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 it is crystal clear that the learned District Judge has the jurisdiction to transfer any case under the provision of the above section not under section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, thus, in passing the impugned order and transferring the instant Title Suit under section 24 of the said Code from the 1st Court of Artha Rin Adalat to the 3rdCourt of the Artha Rin Adalat clearly committed an error of law. Therefore, the impugned order dated 9-4-2007 cannot be sustained in law. 

 11. The impugned order dated 9-4-2007 passed by the learned District Judge in Transfer Miscellaneous Case No.327 of 2002 is hereby set-aside.
